title: Get goal-side, then press
titleKid: Get between them and our goal
brief: Their #6 has the ball. Keep an eye on their #8 as well.
briefKid: Their midfielder has the ball. Watch the other midfielder near you too.
question: Their #8 has it and is running at our goal. Where do you go?
questionKid: Their midfielder is running at our goal. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: When you are nearest the ball, get between it and our goal first, then close the carrier down to a couple of metres.
takeaway.kid: Nearest the ball? Get between it and our goal, then get close.

misconceptions.text: You chased the ball from behind it, so their #8 can still run straight at our goal; get goal-side first.
misconceptions.textKid: Chasing from behind lets them run at our goal. Get between them and goal.

misconceptions.text: You dropped off into space, but now nobody is pressing the ball, so their #8 has all the time they need.
misconceptions.textKid: You are too far away, so get close before they can pass.
